'''1999 San Diego Comic-Con Team Event''' was the Friday team tournament at the 1999 San Diego Comic-Con. [[Hak Soo Kim]] finished first overall. Team Got Force of San Diego won the team prize. The Information Broker ([[Tim Guzman]]) published a report on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or-comic">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/ComiCon99.htm Comic-Con 99'], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029233853/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/ComiCon99.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
